outcome: Time for beta-HCG to return to normal levels
Post-operative thickness of the uterine scar
cohort: The study included patients with cesarean scar pregnancy type II (CSP)-II diagnosed by ultrasound or magnetic resonance imaging.
finding: The study found that laparoscopic resection of the scar with gestational tissue and wound repair was associated with lower beta-HCG levels following surgery, shorter time for beta-HCG to return to normal levels, reduced post-operative thickness of the uterine scar, and reduced menstruation recovery time compared to hysteroscopic treatment.
